subject: CYCLE-3 DISPOSITION: BLOCKED_FIELD_REQUIRED — no physical Fold7 runtime claim
body: Cycle 3 field gate cannot be executed in this research session because no physical Galaxy Z Fold7 runtime is attached. No latency-improvement, first-pixel, useful-presentation, or interactivity runtime claim is made. A 10+ attempt physical matrix plus reversal, privilege-loss, remap, restart, repeated same-generation openings, and present-fence fallback cases is published for the field operator/Manager.
